author: petr1petr
body:
\+view equips for world - you will see much farther

next steps would be new items. and amities that will go together with your build.

get freyr - you already have enough orns. and if you are after crit, the boost will help.

orns - do memorries, check on your achievements.

dont lvl up normal quality equips (unless you have a good reason for it) - joining active kingdom will help with event raids - a lot of people keep some scrolls...

if you want to look ahead, this post includes links to T10 guides: [https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1kep7w1/compendium\_of\_guides\_to\_master\_orna/](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1kep7w1/compendium_of_guides_to_master_orna/)
